votes.motion: Ratify the Town Manager's appointment of Officer Sean Connery and Officer Jack Hebert as Acting Police Sergeant.
votes.quote: mr. sund motioned to ratify the town manager's appointment of officer connery and officer hebert to the positions of acting police sergeant. ms. bertram seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the Lion's Club request for a road block on April 27, 2013.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo motioned to approve the request for a road block on april, 27, 2013 to help support the lion's club. mr. sund seconded the motion.

votes.motion: Approve the new sign in memory of Nance Ware in front of the Ritter Memorial Building.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo motioned to approve the new sign in memory of nance ware in front of the ritter memorial building. ms. bertram seconded. on vote motion carried, 5 in favor, o opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend the CM at Risk method as the construction method for a new school to the School Building Committee.
votes.quote: mi. alonzo motioned to recommend the cm at risk method as the construction method for a new school to the school building committee. mr. sund seconded the motion.

votes.motion: Designate the Board of Health as the main contact and final approval for the Mosquito Control Budget.
votes.quote: mr. sund motioned that the bos designate the board of health to be the main contact and the final approval for the mosquito control budget. ms. bertram seconded.
being no further business mr. debettencourt moved to adjourn the meeting. ms. bertram seconded.
